title: Xi welcomes Trump in Shenzhen ahead of first three-way talks with Putin
caption:
Chinese President Xi Jinping greeted Donald Trump at his plane in Shenzhen for the APEC summit, and Trump and Vladimir Putin shook hands at the leaders' photo. The three leaders are due to hold their first three-way talks on Thursday. Nuclear arms control, Iran and the war in Ukraine are expected on the agenda, but US officials say no agreements are expected yet.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
